accepted_gaps.title: Unbounded-tail exclusion
accepted_gaps.rationale: Finite verification has no automatic extension to all zero heights.

accepted_gaps.title: Hidden universal quantifiers in equivalent criteria
accepted_gaps.rationale: Li and related criteria retain an infinite positivity, approximation, or test-function obligation.

accepted_gaps.title: Unverified external-model bridges in recent claims
accepted_gaps.rationale: Repository claims must show an exact map and a theorem whose hypotheses are met.

accepted_gaps.title: Certified numerical completeness
accepted_gaps.rationale: Numerical evidence is theorem-grade only with explicit error, completeness, and reproducibility certificates.

accepted_gaps.title: Claim of a recognized recent proof
accepted_gaps.rationale: No cross-validated peer-reviewed closure record was found; repository proof declarations are held for audit.
